rootCause: Run-NovaOrynIDE.bat still executed npm workspace commands with C:\NovaOrynIDE as the current working directory after the root package.json was moved into JSON and the executable npm workspace was staged under .toolchain/NpmWorkspace. npm therefore attempted to open C:\NovaOrynIDE\package.json and failed with ENOENT.
fixes: Define .toolchain/NpmWorkspace as the launcher npm workspace.
Run the @theia/cli dependency probe from the staged npm workspace.
Run npm start for @novaoryn/ide-electron from the staged npm workspace.
Require the staged workspace package.json before attempting launch and rebuild if it is absent.
Keep the IDE root free of JSON manifests and bump active release metadata to 0.11.8.
